notes.title: Already second live patch!
notes.content:
Another day another patch.

There was a bug in the achievments system which granted incorrect achievments. It is now fixed!

notes.title: First day patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sorry for the inconvenience but an early patch is already live.

There was an issue when losing the survival mode. Your score is supposed to be only computed when winning the survival mode. Therefore the score is not shown anymore when losing.

A score of 12 was also awarded when starting the tutorial, that is not the case anymore.

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
Today a completely revamped demo build has been pushed!

This demo focus on the survival mode and there are a ton of new things : 
- new units!
- new challenges!
- revamped rune mecanics : runes now can give direct unique bonus to units or even spawn super units!
- runs should now feel more unique!

The multiplayer and duel mode is not available anymore in the demo because I wanted to focus the demo on the main experience that the main game will be!

notes.title: New Demo version for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
A new update hits just before steam next fest!

This update includes the following main features : 

- A new rune : The Fehu rune will boost your economy
- A new mission including a big boss fight
- Multiplayer should now work without slowing down the game

This also includes many fixes and quality of life improvements

notes.title: Update Demo v1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A small patch to the demo containing various bug fixes dans quality of life features : 
- Better UI scaling feature and better default UI size detection
- Fixed an issue preventing duel modeto start
- Added quality of life selection actions when clicking on selected units in the UI: 
  - ctrl + left clic : keep only the clicked units selected
  - ctrl + right clic : keep all the other units (than the one clicked on) selected
  - shift + left clic : remove one unit of the clicked type from the selection
  - shift + right clic : remove half the units of the clicked type from the selection
- Music now loops but its volume has been decreased
- Added missing resource warning
- Added error message when player disconnect from multiplayer
- Added crash message when the in game engine stops.

notes.title: The demo is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, and happy new year everyone![/h1]
It has been a year since I started working on Fair and Square and now it is time to tell you that the beta is out and I need your help to gather feedback!

You can check the trailer here : https://youtu.be/M5i7gTcFSHs

[h1]What is Fair and Square ?[/h1]

Fair and Square is a real time rts trying to reproduce the responsiveness of the best RTS games in that category. Hopefully your army won't die as fast as in Starcraft 2 though.

[h2]What will be in the game?[/h2]
It will feature around 10 missions, a survival mode (all that available in co-op mode) and a pvp mode (no automatic matchmaking for now, its addition will depend on the traction that the game gets during the demo). I also hope to integrate the editor I am using internally but cannot promise anything for now.
[h1]What is different in Fair and Square ?[/h1]

[h2]Dynamic faction[/h2]
Fair and Square is a dynamic and responsive classical RTS BUT you build your faction during the game. Your units are simple shaped powerful beings that can be empowered by runes. Each rune has three tiers and gives you special bonuses and/or units.
[h2]Anchors[/h2]
You unlock runes during the game by building special "anchors'' (more to come in the lore about them) on specific points on the map. Everytime you build an anchor you get to choose between three options of rune.
[h2]PvP[/h2]
To mitigate the randomness in PvP you draft runes at the beginning of the game and end up picking three of them which means that each roll is the same. You just get to pick the one you need at that point of the game. in PvP you will only be able to unlock 6 runes which means you won't be able to max all three runes. You need to plan accordingly.
[h2]What is in the demo for now?[/h2]
Right now there are 4 runes available, there should be 5 in the demo release in early february and 6 in the full game. Why not more ? Because I would rather have 6 interesting runes than 20 bad ones and the existing one will need your feedback to be improved until release!
[h1]What to do with all this?[/h1]
Well if you are curious jump in the demo (or beta), it is free! And give as much feedback as possible in the google form link in the game. But most of all have fun with it!
I am looking for some players to try the duel mode in 1v1 if you want, do not hesitate to join the discord to find players there will be a dedicated channel.
Wishlisting of course helps a lot.
[h1]When does the complete game release?[/h1]
It should release by Q2 2024. I am aiming for a spring release. I cannot be more specific for now sadly.
